title: SoreMachi: And Yet the Town Moves
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hotori Arashiyama, a clumsy, mystery-loving high school girl, works at the Seaside cafe in the Maruko shopping district after its elderly owner, Uki, turns it into a makeshift maid cafe. Episodic chapters follow her friends, family, neighbors and shopkeepers, with occasional stories about aliens, ghosts and the paranormal. Sixteen volumes by Masakazu Ishiguro; winner of the Seiun Award and a Japan Media Arts Festival Excellence Award.
life_message: Everyday neighborhood life, curiosity and looking out for one another make an ordinary town worth loving.
